recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Defending the tropical zodiac as math, not constellations", "body": "Peace Dealer opens by answering the charge that astrologers are not reading the real sky, comparing critics to a wine maker giving expert opinions on neuroscience and calling it an appeal to false authority. He argues the constellations were named after the zodiac rather than the reverse, cites Ophiuchus as a constellation that is not a sign, and traces everything to the sun's ecliptic path, where equal day and equal night on March 20th is what creates Aries. Chance Garton adds that the old priesthoods built written language on pure math, every letter a number, and later traces Jonah, Yuna and Yoni to one root meaning dove."}, {"title": "Pluto leaves Capricorn and the glass shatters", "body": "The forecast centers on Pluto moving from Capricorn into Aquarius. Peace Dealer describes Capricorn as the glass cup that has held the water in place, already cracked by banks crashing and authorities getting exposed, and reads Pluto's 2024 ingress as that glass shattering into the sign of the water bearer. He points back to Pluto's previous Aquarius passages, the American and French revolutions of the 1700s and the English Reformation of the 1500s, and forecasts a decades long unwinding of corporations and democratic order rather than an overnight one. Chance supplies the mechanism: every system eventually reaches peak corruption, and Pluto arrives at that peak."}, {"title": "Building the ark and leaving the old networks", "body": "Both frame 2024 as the year to build an ark. Peace Dealer dates the work to Saturn entering Pisces in March 2023 and its September retrograde, and forecasts that Pluto's retrograde back into Capricorn before its full 2025 ingress is the last window to step out of the dying system. Chance points to networks already forming, naming Owen Benjamin's bear community growing food, sharing skills and bartering off the books, while Peace Dealer reads Uranus in Taurus in creators moving to Rumble. Aquarius, in his telling, replaces the Capricorn model where there is only one Google and one YouTube with distributed options."}, {"title": "Awakened god powers and the energy revolution", "body": "A long stretch turns on what the two call awakened god powers. Chance describes his most recent guest, RJ Spina, who he says channeled energy with his higher mind and reversed a permanent paralysis, and describes his own biofield tuning practice with tuning forks plus the phrase he uses, I invoke the source and singularity of all life. Peace Dealer calls that the real energy revolution of Pluto in Aquarius, forecasts a collective awakening strengthening over the next decade and a half, and predicts an AI revolution and mind driven technology by the time Pluto leaves Aquarius around the 2040s."}, {"title": "The January through April roadmap", "body": "The month by month covers January to April only. Peace Dealer casts January as a prologue, with the North Node in Aries pushing individuality and Mercury going direct, and February as the sun and Saturn kazimi in Pisces he calls over 200 years in the making, alongside a sun Neptune conjunction he dates back roughly 180 years and the Year of the Wood Dragon on February 10th. March is the flood, and he notes Noah's time on the ark nearly matches Saturn's passage through Pisces. For April he forecasts proxy wars climaxing, while Chance previews the total solar eclipse crossing his area."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The mystically illuminated & adept astrologer known as Peace Dealer returns to Vibe Rant to discuss some of the major themes in the sky clock that will play out over the coming year, 2024. What's in the cards for the world as we approach a major Plutonian transit event that will place the transformer of the zodiac firmly in Aquarius for the next 20+ years?

It is a science.", "author": "Peace Dealer", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "It's not the stars themselves having some influence on what expresses here on Earth, per se. They're just a story, the stars were turned into a text to help us remember and retain this information.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Capricorn represents the system, a glass cup that has held the water in place through organization, and Pluto has created cracks in that water: banks crashing, authorities getting exposed, countries collapsing, war.", "author": "Peace Dealer", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "Every system that ever existed, whether biological or artificial, no matter how perfect and well tuned and well crafted and balanced it is, over enough time eventually it will become corrupt.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If you haven't built your ark, Noah's ark, to make it through into this new world, you're going to be washed away.", "author": "Peace Dealer", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "My last guest on the podcast, he got paralyzed from the chest down and he channeled energy with his higher mind into his body and fixed his permanent paralysis.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If Trump is not allowed to run there's going to be some kind of revolution, if he wins there will be a revolution, if he loses there will be a civil war.", "author": "Peace Dealer", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "Life has this tendency to bring what is needed to place where it's needed. Look at that with plants and herbs.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "2023 brought us into this shift and transcendence, 2024 is going to be the actual change, and then 2025 is going to move us in that new direction of the new world order.", "author": "Peace Dealer", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "It's the concept of the legal straw man, the legal fiction, identifying with a fake self that only exists in two-dimensionality on paper or in digital systems and pretending that that's actually you.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "2024 is going to be the beginning of the end of the world, and this is where we are moving on that Noah's ark ride in faith.", "author": "Peace Dealer", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "You're not going to heal trauma just by knowing it was there or how it made you feel, you got to understand how it influenced your behavior.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
